dispatched_brief.objective: Find agents with evidence for slowing functional decline or prolonging survival in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, including approved, trial-stage and off-label evidence, noting the trial phenotype and the strength of the evidence.

facts.source_kind: de-identified abstraction; local ledger holds the chart quotation

constraints: Evidence in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis populations
Report trial phase, phenotype enrolled and outcome measures (functional scale, survival)
Distinguish approved use from investigational or off-label evidence
avoid: Evidence from non-ALS motor neuron conditions presented as ALS evidence
Extrapolating group-level results to individual response
unknowns: Individual response and applicable trial phenotype.
The record does not state the patient's own treatment priorities.
